jobDescription:
Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst — Tier 1/2

Location: Remote (EU)
Employment: Full-time

About the Role
We are growing our 24/7 SOC and are hiring a SOC Analyst to monitor alerts, triage incidents, and escalate as needed. This is a hands-on monitoring role suited to someone early-to-mid in their security career.

Key Responsibilities
- Monitor SIEM alerts and triage security events during your shift.
- Perform first-level investigation of suspicious activity and phishing reports.
- Follow runbooks to contain and escalate incidents.
- Document findings in the ticketing system.
- Tune basic detection rules under senior guidance.

Required Skills
- 1-3 years in a SOC or security monitoring role
- Familiarity with a SIEM (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or similar)
- Understanding of common attack techniques (phishing, malware, brute force)
- Basic networking (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP)
- Ability to follow incident runbooks
- Willingness to work shift rotations

Nice to Have
- Security+ or equivalent entry certification
- Scripting for basic automation
